questions.question: After allowing three successive discounts of 10%, 20% and 5% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for Rs. 2,394. The cost price of the article is Rs. 2,500. If it is sold at the marked price, then the profit will be?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost price of the article is 2,500

**Calculation:**

Let be assume the marked price of the article is x

⇒ x × 90/100 × 80/100 × 95/100 = 2394

⇒ x = 2394/(0.9 × 0.8 × 0.95) = 2394/0.684 = 3500

⇒ Now, profit = 3500 - 2500 = 1000

**∴ The required result will be 1000.**

questions.question: Which of the following is divisible by 88?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

Divisible by 88

**Concept:**

A natural number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of the odd-numbered digits and the sum of even-numbered digits is multiple of 11 or zero.

A natural number is divisible by 8 if the last three digits are zeros or the number formed by the last three-digit is divisible by 8.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 88 is the product of 8 and 11. The number which qualifies at to both divisibility rule of 8 and 11 will be the answer.

⇒ 4987136 will qualify both properties

**∴ The required result will be 4987136.**

questions.question: The lengths of trains A and B are in the ratio of 2 : 3. They pass a static pole in 4 seconds and 5 seconds, respectively. In what time (in seconds) will they cross each other when they move in the same direction?
questions.solution:
**Given;**

The ratio of the length of the train is 2 : 3

**Calculation:**

Let be assume length of the train of A and B is 2x and 3x respectively.

⇒ Speed of train A = 2x/4, Speed of train B = 3x/5

⇒ Speed in same direction = 3x/5 - 2x/4 = 0.10x

⇒ Total time taken to cross each other = (2x + 3x)/0.10x = 5/0.10 = 50 second

**∴ The required result will be 50 second.**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 0, then (x + y - z)³ + (y + z - x)³ + (z + x - y)³ = k(xyz), where k is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 0 ----(1)

(x + y - z)3 + (y + z - x)3 + (z + x - y)3 = k(xyz) ----(2)

**Concept Used:**

if, A + B + C = 0 then, A3 + B3 + C3 = 3ABC

**Calculation:**

Let, x + y - x = A

y + z - x = B 

and, z + x - y = C

Now, A + B + C = (x + y - z) + (y + z - x) + (z + x - y)

⇒ A + B + C = x + y + z = 0 [Using (1)]

We know that if, A + B + C = 0 then, A³ + B³ + C³ = 3ABC

⇒ (x + y - z)3 + (y + z - x)3 + (z + x - y)³ = 3(x + y - z) × (y + z - x) × (z + x - y)

⇒ (x + y - z)3 + (y + z - x)3 + (z + x - y)3 = 3 × (- 2z) × (- 2x) × ( - 2y) [∵ x + y + z = 0 ⇒ x + y = - z

⇒ (x + y - z)3 + (y + z - x)3 + (z + x - y)3 = - 24xyz similarly, y + z = - x and z + x = - y]

Comparing this with (2) get, k = - 24

**∴ Required value of k is - 24.**

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 30 minutes and 37(1)/(2)minutes, respectively. C is an outlet pipe. When all the three pipes are opened together, then the tank is full in 25 minutes. In how much time (in minutes) can C alone empty (2)/(5)th part of the tank?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

All pipe together can fill the tank in 25 min

**Calculation:**

Let us assume pipe C can empty the tank in P min

⇒ One minute's work of A, B, and C together = 1/25

⇒ 1/30 + 2/75 - 1/P = 1/25

⇒ C alone can empty the tank in P = 50 minutes

⇒ C alone can empty the 2/5th tank in = 50 × (2/5) = 20 minutes

**∴ The required result will be 20 minutes.**

questions.question: A sells an article to B at a 20% profit. B sells it to C at a 15% loss. C sells it to D at a 25% profit. If the difference between the profits of A and C is Rs. 49.50, then the cost price of the article for C is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the cost price for A be Rs. x 

⇒ Selling price for A = 120% of x = 6x/5

Cost price for B = 6x/5

⇒ Selling price for B = 85% of 6x/5 = 102x/100

Cost price for C = 102x/100

⇒ Selling price for C = 125% of 102x/100 = 51x/40

Now, Profit of A = S.P of A - C.P of A 

⇒ Profit of A = 6x/5 - x = x/5

Profit of C = S.P of C - C.P of C

⇒ Profit of C = (51x/40) - (102x/100) = 51x/200

Now, According to the question 

(51x/200) - (x/5) = 49.50

⇒ 11x/200 = 49.50

⇒ x = 900

So, C.P for C = 102x/100 = (102 × 900)/100

**∴ C.P for C = Rs. 918**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

**Calculation:**

Let be assume A purchased article at p rupees

⇒ A's profit = 0.20 × p

⇒ B's cost price = 1.2 × p

⇒ C's cost price = 0.85 × 1.2 × p

⇒ C's profit = 0.85 × 1.2 × 0.25 × p

⇒ (0.20 × p) - (0.85 × 1.2 × 0.25 × p) = 49.50

⇒ p × (0.20 - 0.255) = 49.50

⇒ p = 49.50/0.055 = 900

⇒ The cost price of C = 0.85 × 1.2 × 900 = 918

**∴ The required result will be 918.**

questions.question: If the simple interest on a certain sum for 2(2)/(3) years at 15% p.a. is Rs. 514.80 less than simple interest on the same sum for 4(1)/(4)years at 12% p.a., then the sum is?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let be assume the sum is P

⇒ Simple interest for 4.25 years = {P × (17/4) × 12}/100 = 0.51P

⇒ Simple interest for 2.66 years = {P × (8/3) × 15}/100 = 0.40P

⇒ 0.51P - 0.40P = 514.80

⇒ P = 4680

**∴ The required result will be 4680.**

questions.question: When calculated over the selling price, the profit percentage on selling an article is 25%. What is the actual profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

**Calculation:**

⇒ 25% = (Selling price - Cost price)/Selling price

⇒ 25 × Selling price = 100 × Selling price - 100 × Cost price

⇒ 100 × Cost price = 100 × Selling price - 25 Selling price

⇒ 100 × Cost price = 75 × Selling price

⇒ Cost price × (100/75) = Selling price

⇒ Cost price × (4/3) = Selling price

⇒ Now original profit % = (4 - 3)/3 × (100) = 33.33%

**∴ The required result will be 33.33%.**

questions.question: If the speed of a train is increased by 30%, it takes 36 minutes less to cover the same distance. What is the time taken (in hours) to cover the same distance with the original speed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

When speed is increased by 30% time take 36 minutes less

**Calculation:**

Let be assume the speed of the train is S and the distance is D and time is T

⇒ T = D/S .... (1)

⇒ T - 36/60 = D/(130S/100) .... (2)

⇒ By solving equation (1) and (2)

⇒ 0.3T = 0.78

⇒ T = 2.6 hours

**∴ The required result will be 2.6 hours.**

questions.question: The sides of a triangular field are 140 m, 225 m and 265 m. What is the cost of levelling it at Rs. 5.50 per m²?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides of a triangle are 140 m, 225 m, and 265 m

**Calculation:**

Let be assume sides of the triangle is a, b, and c

⇒ The semi perimeter of triangle = (a + b + c)/2 = (140 + 225 + 265)/2 = 630/2 = 315

⇒ Area of triangle = √{s (s - a) (s - b) (s - c)}

⇒ √ {315 × (315 - 140) × (315 - 225) × (315 - 265)} = √248062500 = 15750

⇒ Total cost = 15750 × 5.50 = 86625 

**∴ The required result will be 86625.**

questions.question: Sujatha spends 18% of her monthly income on house rent, 40% of the income on groceries and 55% of the remaining on her children's education and others. If her monthly savings is Rs. 4,725, then her expenditure on 'education and others' is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The monthly saving of Sujatha is 4725.

**Calculation:**

Let be assume the monthly salary of Sujatha is P

⇒ P × (100 - 18 - 40)/100 × (100 - 55)/100 = 4725

⇒ P × (42)/100 × (45)/100 = 4725

⇒ P = 2.5 × 100 × 100 = 25000

⇒ Expenditure on education and others = P × (42/100) × (55/100) = 25000 × 0.231 = 5775

**∴ The required result will be 5775.**

questions.question: The value of a equipment depreciates by 20% each year. If the difference between the prices at the end of 3rd and 4th year is Rs. 3,328, then what is the price of the equipment at the end of the second year?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Price is depreciated by 20% each year

**Calculation:**

Let be assume the original price is x

⇒ After 3 years price = x × 4/5 × 4/5 × 4/5 = (64/125) × x

⇒ After 4 years price =x × 4/5 × 4/5 × 4/5 × 4/5 = (256/625) × x

⇒ {(64/125) - (256/625)} × x = 3328

⇒ 0.1024 × x = 3328

⇒ x = 32500

⇒ For second-year price = 32500 × 4/5 × 4/5 = 20800

**∴ The required result will be 20800.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 6,600 amounts to Rs. 8,756 in 4(2)/(3) years at x% p.a. simple interest. What will the same amounts to if invested at (x + 3)% p.a. for 2(1)/(2)years, interest compounded yearly (nearest to Rs. 1)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sum of 6,600 amounts to 8,756 in 14/3 years at x% p.a. simple interest.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8756 - 6600 = (6600 × 14/3 × x)/100

⇒ x = 2156/308 = 7

⇒ New rate is (x + 3) = 7 + 3 = 10%

⇒ New amounts for two year = 6600 × (110/100)² = 7986

⇒ Interest for next (1/2) year = 7986 × (5/100) = (798.6) × (1/2) = 399.3

⇒ Total amount = 7986 + 399.3 = 8385.3

**∴ The requires result will be 8385.3.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs x is divided between A, B, C and D such that the ratio of the shares of A and B is 4 : 5, that of B and C is 3 : 4 and that of C and D is 5 : 7. If the difference between the shares of B and D is Rs. 3,276, then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference between the shares of B and D is 3276

**Calculation:**

⇒ Shares of A, B, C, and D = 12 : 15 : 20 : 28

⇒ Now 28p - 15p = 3276

⇒ 13p = 3276

⇒ p = 252

⇒ x = p × (12 + 15 + 20 + 28) = 252 × 75 = 18900

**∴ The required result will be 18,900.**

questions.question: In a group of 78 persons, the ratio of the numbers of males and females is 7 : 6. The average height of all the persons is 160.2 cm. If the average height of males is 5% more than that of females, then what is the average height (in cm) of females in the group?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total number of person is 78.

**Calculation:**

Let be assume the average height of female is p

⇒ Total male = 78 × (7/13) = 42, Total female = 78 - 42 = 36

⇒ Total height of all person = 160.2 × 78 = 12495.6

⇒ The average height of males = p × (105/100) = 21p/20

⇒ Total sum of height of male = (21p/20) × 42 = 44.1

⇒ Total sum of height of female = p × 36

⇒ 36p + 44.1p = 12495.6

⇒ 80.1p = 12495.6

⇒ p = 156

**∴ The required result will be 156.**

questions.question: X is 35% less than Y, Z is 40% more than the sum of X and Y. By what percent is Z more than two times X (correct to one decimal place)?
The average of five consecutive even numbers (in increasing order) is *k*. If the next four consecutive even numbers are included, then the average of all the numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of five consecutive even numbers is k.

**Calculation:**

Let be assume numbers x, x + 2, x + 4, x + 6, x + 8, and next four is x + 10, x + 12, x + 14, x + 16

⇒ (x + x + 2 + x + 4 + x + 6 + x + 8)/5 = k

⇒ 5x + 20 = 5k, x + 4 = k

⇒ (x + 10 + x + 12 + x + 14 + x + 16 + 5x + 20)/9 = (9x + 72)/9 = x + 8 = x + 4 + 4 = k + 4

⇒ The average = k + 4

**∴ The required result will be "k + 4".**

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum for 1 year at 8% p.a., interest compounded half - yearly is Rs. 652.80. What will be the simple interest on the same sum for 2 (1)/(2) years at the same rate of interest ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Compound interest on a certain sum is 652.80

**Concept:**

Compound interest = P × {(1 + R/100)T - 1} Where, P = Principle, T = Time, R = Rate

**Calculation:**

Let be assume the principle is P and the rate for half-yearly = 8/2 = 4% T = 2 

⇒ P × {(1 + 4/100)² - 1} = 652.80

⇒ P = 8000

⇒ Simple interest = (8000 × 4 × 5)/100 = 1600

**∴ The required result will be 1600.**

questions.question: Four years ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B was 9 : 13. Eight years hence, the ratio of the ages of A and B will be 3 : 4. What will be the ratio of their ages 4 years hence?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Four year ago the ratio of age of A and B is 9 : 13

**Calculation:**

Let the age of A and B, 4 years ago = 9x and 13x

So, the present age of A and B, respectively = 9x + 4 and 13x +4

Eight years hence, the ratio of the ages of A and B = 3/4

⇒ (9x + 4 + 8)/(13x + 4 + 8) = 3/4

⇒ 36x + 48 = 39x + 36

⇒ x = 4

⇒ Present age of A = 9 × 4 + 4 = 40

⇒ Present age of B = 13 × 4 + 4 = 56

⇒ The ratio after 4 years = (40 + 4)/(56 + 4) = 44/60 = 11/15

**∴ The required result will be 11/15.**

questions.question: The average of 21 numbers is 66. The average of the first 9 numbers is 63.7 and that of the last 13 numbers is 69.9. If the 9th number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 21 number is 66

**Calculation:**

Total sum of 21 number = 21 × 66 = 1386

The sum of first 9 number = 63.7 × 9 = 573.3

The sum of last 13 number = 69.9 × 13 = 908.7

The 9th number = (The sum of last 13 number + The sum of first 9 number) - Total sum of 21 number

⇒ (573.3 + 908.7) - 1386 

⇒ 1482 - 1386 = 96

When 9th number is excluded than sum = 1386 - 96 = 1290

New average = 1290/20 = 64.5

**∴ The required result will be 64.5.**
